## 1. Services

RelayAI will provide the Client with an AI-powered customer enquiry agent ("the Agent") that operates on the Client's behalf to:

- Respond to inbound customer enquiries via the agreed channels (WhatsApp, web chat, or both)
- Collect and store customer contact information in the Client's CRM
- Answer common questions based on information provided by the Client
- Escalate complex or sensitive enquiries to the Client's nominated contact

The specific scope of work is detailed in the attached [Statement of Work](statement-of-work.md).

## 2. Term

This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues on a **month-to-month** basis. Either party may terminate with **14 days' written notice** via email.

## 3. Fees

|------|------------------------------|----------------------|

**Selected Plan:** ____________________

- Fees are billed monthly in advance on the 1st of each month
- Payment is due within 7 days of invoice
- Conversations exceeding the included limit will be billed at $X per additional conversation
- GST will be added where applicable

## 4. Setup Fee

A one-time setup fee of $XXX (excl. GST) applies, covering:
- Discovery and requirements gathering
- System prompt development and testing
- CRM integration configuration
- Channel setup (WhatsApp and/or web widget)
- Initial testing and go-live support

## 5. Client Responsibilities

The Client agrees to:

- Provide accurate and complete business information for the Agent's knowledge base
- Provide access to CRM systems and any necessary API keys or credentials
- Respond to escalated enquiries within a reasonable timeframe
- Notify RelayAI of any changes to business information (services, pricing, hours, etc.)
- Not use the Agent for any unlawful purpose

## 6. Data & Privacy

- Customer data collected by the Agent is stored in the Client's own CRM system
- Conversation logs are stored on RelayAI's servers for service delivery and support purposes
- RelayAI will not share, sell, or use Client or customer data for any purpose other than delivering the agreed services
- Both parties agree to comply with the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs)
- Data is hosted on Australian or APAC-region servers where available
- The Client is the data controller; RelayAI acts as data processor

## 7. Uptime & Support

- RelayAI targets 99% uptime for the Agent service (measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance)
- Support is available via email (hello@relayai.com.au) during business hours (9am-5pm ACST, Mon-Fri)
- Critical issues (Agent completely non-responsive) will be addressed within 4 business hours
- Non-critical issues within 1 business day

## 8. Limitations

- The Agent is an AI system and may occasionally provide incorrect or unexpected responses. RelayAI is not liable for decisions made by customers based on Agent responses.
- The Agent does not replace professional advice (medical, legal, financial, etc.)
- Response quality depends on the accuracy and completeness of information provided by the Client

## 9. Intellectual Property

- The Agent platform, software, and underlying technology remain the property of RelayAI
- The Client's business information, customer data, and system prompt content remain the property of the Client
- Upon termination, the Client's data will be exported and provided within 14 days upon request

## 10. Termination

- Either party may terminate with 14 days' written notice
- Upon termination, RelayAI will disable the Agent and remove the Client's configuration
- The Client is responsible for removing the widget code from their website
- No refunds for partial months

## 11. Limitation of Liability

RelayAI's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid by the Client in the 3 months preceding the claim. RelayAI is not liable for indirect, consequential, or incidental damages.

## 12. Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of South Australia, Australia.
